name: The St. Regis Punta Mita Resort
positioning: Beachfront St. Regis resort on a Pacific peninsula in Punta de Mita, Riviera Nayarit, decorated with Mexican art and handcrafted furnishings
best_for: Families wanting a complimentary kids' club and villas with private pools and kitchens
Golfers who want a 36-hole Jack Nicklaus course
Travelers drawn to Mexican design and traditional spa rituals such as Temazcal

facts.text: The resort sits on 22 acres on a peninsula in Punta de Mita, overlooking the Pacific Ocean.
The resort is inside a 1,500-acre enclave, shared with neighboring hotels and residences, that has more than nine miles of private beach.
The resort showcases Mexican art and handcrafted furnishings, with design rooted in the spirit of Riviera Nayarit.
Rooms and suites are decorated with artworks from local workshops, and butler service is included in every room category.
Room interiors have exposed wood-beam ceilings, terra-cotta floors and artisan-crafted tapestries.
Each beachfront villa has a private pool and a fully equipped kitchen.
The resort first opened in 2008 and was comprehensively refreshed in 2023, led by Bibiana Huber of B-Huber architecture studio in Guadalajara.
Carolina is named for New York socialite Caroline Astor and offers a seasonal 10-course tasting menu.
The Mita Mary restaurant serves seafood made with Pacific coastal ingredients, grilled on the beach.
The resort's own Bloody Mary, the Mita Mary, is made with white tequila and other local ingredients.
The spa's Couples' Retreat Cabin has a heated pool and a private lounge area.
The St. Regis Family Traditions kids' club is complimentary, with a welcome kit of sand toys, cooking classes and movies with snacks.

highlights.text: A champagne sabering ceremony marks the transition from day to night at sunset every day.
The three-bedroom Presidential Villa has a private pool, multiple terraces and views of the Marietas Islands.
The spa offers a Temazcal experience drawing on Huichol tradition.
Every Friday at Sea Breeze Beach, guests can pick their catch of the day, brought in by local fishermen, with the Executive Chef.
Guests can play a 36-hole Jack Nicklaus golf course framed by the Pacific Ocean and Banderas Bay.

considerations.text: The resort is about 45 minutes from Puerto Vallarta International Airport.
Some casitas have steps at the entryway, so guests needing step-free access should say so when booking.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the premium positioning.
